## About this dataset

This historical, anonymized sample follows orders through items, payments, delivery, review scores, products, sellers, and a marketing-qualified-lead funnel. It is useful for questions about price, freight, delivery performance, repeat customers, satisfaction, product mix, seller performance, acquisition channels, and conversion.

Release-local pseudonymous keys preserve useful relationships without releasing customer, reviewer, seller, or employee identities.

## Files

| File | Rows | One row represents | Primary key |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [`olist_orders.parquet`](https://data.60land.com/project1/2026-fall/v1/olist/olist_orders.parquet) | 99,441 | One marketplace order | `order_key` |
| [`olist_order_items.parquet`](https://data.60land.com/project1/2026-fall/v1/olist/olist_order_items.parquet) | 112,650 | One item sequence within an order | `order_key`, `order_item_number` |
| [`olist_payments.parquet`](https://data.60land.com/project1/2026-fall/v1/olist/olist_payments.parquet) | 103,886 | One payment sequence within an order | `order_key`, `payment_sequence` |
| [`olist_reviews.parquet`](https://data.60land.com/project1/2026-fall/v1/olist/olist_reviews.parquet) | 98,673 | One reviewed order with aggregated scores | `order_key` |
| [`olist_products.parquet`](https://data.60land.com/project1/2026-fall/v1/olist/olist_products.parquet) | 32,951 | One product | `product_key` |
| [`olist_sellers.parquet`](https://data.60land.com/project1/2026-fall/v1/olist/olist_sellers.parquet) | 3,095 | One seller | `seller_key` |
| [`olist_marketing_leads.parquet`](https://data.60land.com/project1/2026-fall/v1/olist/olist_marketing_leads.parquet) | 8,000 | One sampled marketing-qualified lead | `lead_key` |
| [`olist_order_analysis.parquet`](https://data.60land.com/project1/2026-fall/v1/olist/olist_order_analysis.parquet) | 99,441 | One order with selected commercial, review, and delivery summaries | `order_key` |

## How the files relate

`order_key` connects orders, items, payments, reviews, and the analysis table. Items then connect to products with `product_key` and sellers with `seller_key`. `customer_key` identifies repeat orders by the same anonymized customer. Converted marketing leads may connect to sellers with `seller_key`.

Orders, items, and payments have different grains. Joining items and payments directly by `order_key` can multiply both item prices and payment amounts. Aggregate each to one row per order first, or begin with `olist_order_analysis.parquet`.

## Example: build an order-level item summary

```r
library(arrow)
library(dplyr)

base_url <- "https://data.60land.com/project1/2026-fall/v1/olist/"

orders <- read_parquet(paste0(base_url, "olist_orders.parquet"))
items <- read_parquet(paste0(base_url, "olist_order_items.parquet"))

item_summary <- items |>
  group_by(order_key) |>
  summarize(
    item_count = n(),
    merchandise_value = sum(item_price, na.rm = TRUE),
    freight_value = sum(freight_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

order_level <- orders |>
  left_join(item_summary, by = "order_key")
```

## Important limitations

- Review scores exist only for reviewed orders and are not a random satisfaction survey.
- Delivery outcomes occur after purchase and create leakage in a purchase-time prediction.
- The marketing file is a sampled funnel; it is not a complete census of every lead or seller.
- Source timestamps do not include a timezone.
- This is a historical Brazilian sample and should not be generalized to current U.S. e-commerce without justification.

## Provenance and privacy

The source datasets are Olist's [Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/olistbr/brazilian-ecommerce) and [Marketing Funnel](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/olistbr/marketing-funnel-olist). Names, comments, review identifiers, and sales-representative identifiers are excluded. Geography is limited to state, normalized city, and five-digit Brazilian postal-code prefix.
